name: lookoutequipment
description: Amazon Lookout for Equipment is a machine learning service that uses advanced analytics to identify anomalies in machines from sensor data for use in predictive maintenance.

subcommands.name: create-dataset
subcommands.description: Creates a container for a collection of data being ingested for analysis.

subcommands.name: create-inference-scheduler
subcommands.description: Creates a scheduled inference.

subcommands.name: create-label
subcommands.description: Creates a label for an event.

subcommands.name: create-label-group
subcommands.description: Creates a group of labels.

subcommands.name: create-model
subcommands.description: Creates a machine learning model for data inference.

subcommands.name: create-retraining-scheduler
subcommands.description: Creates a retraining scheduler on the specified model.

subcommands.name: delete-dataset
subcommands.description: Deletes a dataset and associated artifacts.

subcommands.name: delete-inference-scheduler
subcommands.description: Deletes an inference scheduler that has been set up.

subcommands.name: delete-label
subcommands.description: Deletes a label.

subcommands.name: delete-label-group
subcommands.description: Deletes a group of labels.

subcommands.name: delete-model
subcommands.description: Deletes a machine learning model currently available for Amazon Lookout for Equipment.

subcommands.name: delete-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the resource policy attached to the resource.

subcommands.name: delete-retraining-scheduler
subcommands.description: Deletes a retraining scheduler from a model.

subcommands.name: describe-data-ingestion-job
subcommands.description: Provides information on a specific data ingestion job such as creation time, dataset ARN, and status.

subcommands.name: describe-dataset
subcommands.description: Provides a JSON description of the data in each time series dataset, including names, column names, and data types.

subcommands.name: describe-inference-scheduler
subcommands.description: Specifies information about the inference scheduler being used, including name, model, status, and associated metadata

subcommands.name: describe-label
subcommands.description: Returns the name of the label.

subcommands.name: describe-label-group
subcommands.description: Returns information about the label group.

subcommands.name: describe-model
subcommands.description: Provides a JSON containing the overall information about a specific machine learning model, including model name and ARN, dataset, training and evaluation information, status, and so on.

subcommands.name: describe-model-version
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a specific machine learning model version.

subcommands.name: describe-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Provides the details of a resource policy attached to a resource.

subcommands.name: describe-retraining-scheduler
subcommands.description: Provides a description of the retraining scheduler, including information such as the model name and retraining parameters.

subcommands.name: import-dataset
subcommands.description: Imports a dataset.

subcommands.name: import-model-version
subcommands.description: Imports a model that has been trained successfully.

subcommands.name: list-data-ingestion-jobs
subcommands.description: Provides a list of all data ingestion jobs, including dataset name and ARN, S3 location of the input data, status, and so on.

subcommands.name: list-datasets
subcommands.description: Lists all datasets currently available in your account, filtering on the dataset name.

subcommands.name: list-inference-events
subcommands.description: Lists all inference events that have been found for the specified inference scheduler.

subcommands.name: list-inference-executions
subcommands.description: Lists all inference executions that have been performed by the specified inference scheduler.

subcommands.name: list-inference-schedulers
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of all inference schedulers currently available for your account.

subcommands.name: list-label-groups
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the label groups.

subcommands.name: list-labels
subcommands.description: Provides a list of labels.

subcommands.name: list-model-versions
subcommands.description: Generates a list of all model versions for a given model, including the model version, model version ARN, and status.

subcommands.name: list-models
subcommands.description: Generates a list of all models in the account, including model name and ARN, dataset, and status.

subcommands.name: list-retraining-schedulers
subcommands.description: Lists all retraining schedulers in your account, filtering by model name prefix and status.

subcommands.name: list-sensor-statistics
subcommands.description: Lists statistics about the data collected for each of the sensors that have been successfully ingested in the particular dataset.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all the tags for a specified resource, including key and value.

subcommands.name: put-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Creates a resource control policy for a given resource.

subcommands.name: start-data-ingestion-job
subcommands.description: Starts a data ingestion job.

subcommands.name: start-inference-scheduler
subcommands.description: Starts an inference scheduler.

subcommands.name: start-retraining-scheduler
subcommands.description: Starts a retraining scheduler.

subcommands.name: stop-inference-scheduler
subcommands.description: Stops an inference scheduler.

subcommands.name: stop-retraining-scheduler
subcommands.description: Stops a retraining scheduler.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Associates a given tag to a resource in your account.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes a specific tag from a given resource.

subcommands.name: update-active-model-version
subcommands.description: Sets the active model version for a given machine learning model.

subcommands.name: update-inference-scheduler
subcommands.description: Updates an inference scheduler.

subcommands.name: update-label-group
subcommands.description: Updates the label group.

subcommands.name: update-model
subcommands.description: Updates a model in the account.

subcommands.name: update-retraining-scheduler
subcommands.description: Updates a retraining scheduler.
